title: CampusConnect: Academic Collab Hub
tagline: Realtime peer-to-peer study rooms, notes repository & course forum for college students.
description: Engineered a collaborative academic platform featuring live WebRTC study rooms, collaborative markdown notes, peer resource sharing, and course question boards with voting.
highlights: Role-based access control for students and campus mentors

title: YatriSense: AI Student Copilot
tagline: Automated lecture summarizer, flashcard generator & smart revision schedule optimizer.
description: An intelligent student assistant that ingests lecture PDFs/audio, generates structured concept maps, and uses spaced repetition algorithms to dynamically schedule revision tasks before exams.
highlights: RAG pipeline over 300+ pages of academic textbooks

title: PolyVerse 3D: Virtual Campus Tour
tagline: Interactive WebGL 3D architectural exploration of university landmarks and labs.
description: An immersive browser-based 3D campus navigation experience using Three.js and GLTF models, enabling incoming freshmen to explore lecture halls, libraries, and lab facilities interactively.
highlights: 60 FPS smooth rendering on mobile and desktop GPUs
Interactive 3D hotspots triggering audio guide clips
Optimized asset loading with Draco mesh compression

title: DevSprint: Cloud Code Playground
tagline: Sandboxed browser IDE supporting multiple languages with instant execution.
description: Built an online coding playground with secure containerized execution runners for Python, C++, and JavaScript, supporting live pair-programming and test case evaluation.
highlights: Isolated Docker container execution per user session
Monaco editor with full syntax highlighting & IntelliSense

title: HostelCart: Campus Marketplace
tagline: Verified peer-to-peer buy, sell & rent platform exclusively for hostel residents.
description: Designed a secure marketplace for students to exchange textbooks, cycles, dorm essentials, and electronics with OTP campus email verification and in-app chat.
highlights: 500+ active student registrations within 2 weeks of launch
Geo-fenced pickup point recommendations inside campus

title: AlgoVisualizer 3D
tagline: Step-by-step spatial 3D visualization of Graph, Tree, and Sorting algorithms.
description: An educational tool transforming abstract data structures (Dijkstra, A*, Red-Black Trees, Quicksort) into intuitive 3D spatial node networks with time-travel step controls.
highlights: Dynamic 3D camera zoom and rotation around graph nodes
Customizable animation playback speed & step-back engine
Used by 200+ batchmates for semester exam preparation
